uncheckedChannels: CAR-07 non-speech audio: the source has an AAC audio track, but the repaired run cites only media metadata. No audio-derived artifact or audio inspection action establishes music, effects, inserted audio, silence, rhythm, or their relation to the visual edit. Marking CAR-07 inspected=true is therefore a self-asserted/empty gate.

judgeStatus.reason: JUDGE is prohibited because the unchecked-channel and independent meta gates fail. The five numeric values are schema-required non-evaluative sentinels and must not be interpreted as scores.

unguardedCarriers: Available non-speech audio was not actually inspected: SRC-MEDIA-METADATA proves only that an AAC track exists, while CAR-07 and the internal metaGate claim closure without audio evidence.
metaAudit.rationale: The repair closes the four prior content discrepancies, but it still lets the candidate prove its own audio closure. Probe CAR-07 says the channel is available and inspected, while its only downstream evidence explicitly says the toolchain cannot identify the channel's content or narrative role. This is the evaluator-design empty-gate anti-pattern, so the independent meta-gate fails.

gateDecision.rationale: All six counted content metrics pass their thresholds and all four prior repair targets are closed, but hard gates are conjunctive. Canonical deterministic validation passes 17/22 checks and independently confirms five failures: the non-speech-audio sweep, unregistered resampled OCR execution, three out-of-range comparison frames in KU-23, the evaluator's unchecked-channel gate, and the independent meta-gate. JUDGE does not run.
